Name of Test Case: Staff authentication with valid email and password
Action to Take: Navigate to '#/staff', enter staff email 'admin@example.org', staff password, and click 'Sign in'.
Expected Outcome: Calls /admin/login endpoint, receives verified session token, stores token, and renders Staff Dashboard.

Name of Test Case: Display error banner on invalid login credentials
Action to Take: Enter wrong password and click 'Sign in'.
Expected Outcome: Form remains on screen; displays error banner 'Invalid password. Please check and try again.'

Action to Take: On Overview tab, click 'Connect Stripe' onboarding button.
Expected Outcome: Calls /admin/stripe/connect endpoint and redirects to Stripe Connect OAuth flow.

Name of Test Case: Create a new church fund with fundraising dollar goal
Action to Take: On 'Funds & trips' tab, click '+ Add fund', enter name 'Roof Repair', goal '15000', and click Save.
Expected Outcome: Calls POST /admin/funds; adds new fund to active funds list and makes available on Give page.

Name of Test Case: Create a new mission trip with dates and target budget
Action to Take: Click '+ Add trip', enter destination 'Honduras', departure date, return date, cost '$1,800', and submit.
Expected Outcome: Calls POST /admin/trips; creates mission trip entity; publishes card on '#/give/trips'.

Name of Test Case: Review and approve volunteer mission trip application
Action to Take: On 'Applications' tab, click 'Approve' on applicant 'David Lee' for Honduras trip.
Expected Outcome: Calls PATCH /admin/applications/:id with status 'approved'; updates applicant badge to Approved.

Name of Test Case: View confidential donor gifts ledger table
Action to Take: Click 'Gifts' tab in staff dashboard navigation.
Expected Outcome: Renders secure gifts table showing donor names, emails, funds, amounts, timestamps, and Stripe charge IDs.

Name of Test Case: Sign out of staff session and return to visitor view
Action to Take: Click 'Sign out' button in staff dashboard header.
Expected Outcome: Calls /admin/logout, purges staff session token from storage, and returns UI to visitor browsing mode.

Name of Test Case: Staff session verification during giving microservice outage
Action to Take: Sign in as staff when giving service is temporarily unreachable.
Expected Outcome: Displays cached offline staff view or retry countdown.

Name of Test Case: Invite staff member with duplicate email address
Action to Take: Invite an email that is already registered as a staff member.
Expected Outcome: Displays inline error stating user already exists in team.
